Make a unary gRPC call

Source: R/call.R
grpc_call.Rd

Sends one request message to a method and returns the one response message, with the server's initial and trailing metadata. The request is already encoded, for example by zuproto::proto_encode(); zugrpc only frames it. A call that ends with a status other than OK raises a condition instead of returning.

Usage

grpc_call(channel, method, request, metadata = NULL, deadline = NULL)

Arguments

channel

A channel from grpc_channel().

method

The full method name, "/package.Service/Method".

request

The encoded request message, a raw vector.

metadata

Request metadata: a named character vector, or a named list whose -bin entries are raw vectors. Names are lower-cased. Names starting with grpc-, te and content-type are reserved.

deadline

Seconds from now, or an absolute POSIXct, by which the call must finish. It is sent to the server as grpc-timeout and also bounds the request locally. NULL sets no deadline.

Value

A list with elements message (raw, the response message), headers and trailers (named lists of the initial and trailing metadata, with -bin values as raw vectors) and status ("OK").

Errors

A non-OK status raises zugrpc_error_status, whose class also carries the status as zugrpc_error_<name>, for example zugrpc_error_unavailable. Its fields are grpc_status, grpc_code, grpc_message, http_status, method, headers and trailers. A response that is not gRPC, or breaks its framing, raises zugrpc_error_protocol. See grpc_status_codes().

Examples

# A test server, from zuhttp's mock transport: it answers every call with
# an empty message and status OK.
fake <- zuhttp::zu_mock_transport(function(req) {
  zuhttp::zu_response(
    200L,
    headers = c("content-type" = "application/grpc+proto"),
    body = as.raw(c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0)),
    trailers = c("grpc-status" = "0")
  )
})
ch <- grpc_channel(
  "http://localhost:50051",
  client = zuhttp::zu_client(transport = fake)
)
res <- grpc_call(ch, "/grpc.testing.TestService/EmptyCall", raw())
res$status
#> [1] "OK"
res$message
#> raw(0)
